## Configuration Reference

This page documents all configuration types and their defaults across all languages.

### MergeParserRequirements

Constraints for the eventual TreeHaver negotiation, never direct parser calls.
Empty sets add no constraint. These sets have no preference-order semantics.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `allowed_backend_ids` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Allowed backend ids |
| `forbidden_backend_ids` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Forbidden backend ids |
| `allowed_backend_families` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Allowed backend families |
| `forbidden_backend_families` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Forbidden backend families |
| `languages` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Languages |
| `dialects` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Dialects |
| `contracts` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Contracts |
| `capabilities` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Capabilities |
| `profiles` | `list\[str\]` | `[]` | Profiles |

### TemplateSessionOptions

Portable string paths replace OS-specific PathBuf at the binding boundary.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `mode` | `DirectorySessionMode` | — | Mode (directory session mode) |
| `template_root` | `str` | — | Template root |
| `destination_root` | `str` | — | Destination root |
| `context` | `TemplateDestinationContext` | — | Context (template destination context) |
| `default_strategy` | `TemplateStrategy` | — | Default strategy (template strategy) |
| `overrides` | `list\[TemplateStrategyOverride\]` | — | Overrides |
| `replacements` | `dict\[str, str\]` | — | Replacements |
| `allowed_families` | `list\[str\] \| None` | `None` | Allowed families |
| `config` | `TemplateTokenConfig \| None` | `None` | Config (template token config) |
